description: Purpose of this region: work items — what needs doing, who is on it, and where it stands.
content:
This region tracks work.

Belongs here: what is to be done, why, who owns it, its current state, and what blocks it. Use a follow-up date on an entry that must be returned to; it will surface in every recall until the entry is read.

Does not belong here: an idea nobody has committed to (scope.org_suggestions), or the record of how something was carried out afterwards (scope.site_development).

Several agents may work here at once. Say plainly in an entry when you have taken it on, so two do not do the same work twice.
